A [[human]]<ref name="Messenger" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Who Are You? AD" /> '''reporter''' was present at [[Palmo Plaza]] on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Messenger" /> he<ref name="Who Are You? AD" /> detailed recent events that occurred in [[Palmo]] from the plaza<ref name="Messenger" /> for the [[Imperial HoloNews]].<ref name="EmmyQA" /> Later, he was present in the plaza shortly before the [[Ghorman Massacre]] erupted, being taken into the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial office complex|complex]] by two [[Imperial security trooper|security troopers]].<ref name="Who Are You?">{{Andor|Who Are You?}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The reporter appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's seventh episode, "[[Messenger]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Messenger" /> on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed|date=2025-03-24}}</ref> The reporter was portrayed [[Jonathan Rhodes]] and listed in the series' credits as simply "Reporter #1."<ref name="Messenger" />
